thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-gateway (eu-west1) 5xx-rate jump -> 18% (threshold 10%). PD: INC-8234. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inference/kv-proxy-fallthrough :rotating_light:
alex: Taking this oncall. Thanks for the ping.
sam: Acked PD INC-8234 and jumping in. Pulling traces + logs now.
pagerduty-bot: INC-8234 acknowledged by sam. Status: acknowledged. Responders: alex, sam.
mira: Noted customer noise — Support reports increased timeouts for a few EU tenants. Any initial hypothesis?
sam: Early telemetry shows spike in backend 502s from kv-proxy pool, lots of keepalive resets from edge -> proxy. Could be connection churn causing fallthrough to downstream and retries.
alex: If it's kv-proxy, quick mitigations: scale proxies or reroute traffic to primary pool. Runbook step 2 suggests scaling replicas first.
sam: Doing a light scale + rolling restart of the most noisy pod (proxy-eu-4). Command:```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=6 && kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy```
ops-bot: kubectl scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=6 -n inference -> accepted.
ops-bot: rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy -n inference -> initiated on 3/3 pods.
sam: Scale + restart done. Watching error rate and request latencies.
incidentbot: Metric update: 5xx-rate dropping to 11% (5m window). If it goes <10% and stays, PD will auto-resolve after 10m of stability. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mira: I'll tee up a short customer note in the support triage doc and flag the impacted tenants.
alex: Plan: monitor for 10m. If it creeps back >12% we'll consider temporary region-weight shift to us-west as a fallback. I'll handoff to night oncall (inge) in 15m if stable.
sam: Putting log snippet in thread for context:
```
[2026-03-17T13:21:02Z] proxy-eu-4 connection reset by peer: keepalive timeout=22s, upstream=10.1.2.45
[2026-03-17T13:21:05Z] 502 from kv-backend id=kv-prim-2 latency=320ms
[2026-03-17T13:22:10Z] retry policy triggered -> 5xx spike window start
```
inge: Acked. I'll be on-standby during handoff and will escalate to infra if 5xx > 10% for 5m straight.
sam: Leaving a brief note in the runbook channel with the commands we ran and pod ids.
incidentbot: Alert stable — 5xx at 7% (5m). PD INC-8234 will auto-resolve if stability holds. :white_check_mark:
alex: Thanks everyone. Handing off to inge in 10m. If anything flares, mention @inge and file a follow-up in incidents/ Postmortem channel.
mira: Thx — support will keep customers informed.
pagerduty-bot: INC-8234 auto-resolved after stability period.
inge: Confirmed, monitoring logs. No further action from my side unless it recurs.
